_notes.CITABLE: only these may be quoted INSIDE an appeal letter
_notes.FILING_CRITICAL: values that drive a filing action; below CITABLE they are REMOVED not labelled (suppress_unsourced_filing_fields)
_notes.stated_verbal: sufficient to investigate and to file EARLY; NEVER sufficient to establish the outer bound of a deadline
_notes.why_defaults: 'shortest wins' is a DEADLINE rule. It is unsafe for levels (forecloses escalation), docs (files an incomplete package), channels (may drop the only working one), and INVERTED for recoupment lookback. Unclassified predicates must BLOCK, not guess.
